description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform: Cloud API for messaging and calling, plus management APIs.
auth_notes: Access token sent as Authorization: Bearer from a Meta app; a temporary token can be generated in API Setup. MCP server uses OAuth.
gate_detail: Developers register, create a Meta app and generate a temporary test token. Permissions may need App Review submission, and partners onboard as Tech Providers. Messages are charged per delivery by category.
api_scope: Cloud API for messages and calls, Marketing Messages API, Business Management API, Groups API, templates and webhooks.
mcp_notes: Meta runs an official WhatsApp Business Tools MCP in beta; its URL is blank in the sources.
blocker_detail: Permissions may require App Review ('if applicable') and Tech Provider onboarding for serving clients; per-message charges apply.

evidence.quote: Click **Generate access token** to generate a temporary access token to send a test message.
View required and optional permissions for this use case and add them to an App Review submission, if applicable.
Cloud API Send and receive WhatsApp messages, make WhatsApp calls, and more from your business phone number.
Authentication and authorization Learn how access controls and permissions work on the platform.
Meta runs official remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that bring Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta Ads capabilities to your agentic workflows.

uncertainties: Whether production use needs business verification or App Review is not stated definitively
Sandbox status unclear beyond test token and test webhook
